title: Loop Contract
description: Declarative description of a repeatable agent workflow: trigger, cadence, state spine, hard stops, and review gates.

id.description: Unique identifier for the loop contract.

title.description: Human-readable title for the loop contract.

type.description: The trigger type that initiates this loop.

enabled.description: Whether the trigger is currently enabled.

stateSpine.description: Path to the durable state artifact recording loop progress and resume point.

inputs.description: Named input sources the loop consumes.

skills.description: Skill identifiers the loop may reference.

connectors.description: Connector contract IDs the loop may use.

triageOutputs.description: Valid triage classifications the loop can produce.

maxIterations.description: Maximum number of iterations before the loop must stop.

timeoutMinutes.description: Maximum wall-clock minutes before the loop must stop.

noProgressDetection.description: Whether the loop must detect and stop on repeated no-progress observations.

budget.description: Resource budget ceiling for the loop.

reviewGates.description: Required review gates before work is considered complete.

executesAnything.description: Must always be false — live loop execution is outside the product boundary.

governed.description: Optional human-triggered, governance-gated command. Orthogonal to execution.executesAnything (which stays false — the loop never runs anything on its own). Run only by `amber loop run --execute` after policy + approval gates.

command.description: Shell command executed after the policy and approval gates pass.
